stories.title: Grand Theft Auto VI’s long-overdue gameplay reveal – as it happens
stories.summary: Under some strange circumstances, Rockstar is broadcasting the first (official) gameplay footage of Grand Theft Auto VI, the most-anticipated game of the year. Follow along for everything you need to know. Hello and welcome to the Guardian’s GTA 6 liveblog! stories.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI’s long-overdue gameplay reveal – as it happens

opening: Under some strange circumstances, Rockstar is broadcasting the first (official) gameplay footage of Grand Theft Auto VI, the most-anticipated game of the year.
Follow along for everything you need to know.
body: Hello and welcome to the Guardian’s GTA 6 liveblog!
I’m Keza MacDonald, video games editor, and along with our games correspondent Keith Stuart I’ll be taking you through all the context around the upcoming reveal of the biggest game of the decade.
In about 15 minutes, Rockstar Games will broadcast the first gameplay footage of Grand Theft Auto 6 via Netflix.
This game – more than a decade in the making – is sure to be one of the most successful (and most expensive) games ever made, quite.
